newsitem.title: USA: Brylane sees lower costs, $6.5 mln Q1 charge.
newsitem.headline: Brylane sees lower costs, $6.5 mln Q1 charge.

text.p: Brylane Inc said Friday it had refinanced its bank credit facility and would realize reduced interest costs and the elimination of deferred financing fees, which will provide a pretax benefit of $1.9 million for the remaining nine months of fiscal 1997, or about $0.06 per share after tax.
Brylane said it will recognize annual savings of about $2.5 million before taxes, or $0.08 per share after tax.
In the first quarter, ending May 3, the company will record a one-time pre-tax extraordinary charge of $6.5 million related to the elimination of deferred financing fees, it said.
